name: Magnétanque
biography: Magnes levirotunda. A rotund magnetic elemental that senses iron through solid rock, locks armoured foes in its grip, and detonates arcanomagnetic pulses. Habitat: Hill & Mountain.

features.name: Arcanomagnetic Field
features.description: Ranged attack rolls made with ferrous ammunition and ranged spell attacks against the magnétanque have Disadvantage.

features.name: Ferrosense
features.description: The magnétanque can sense any ferrous objects within 120 feet of it, including through Total Cover.

features.name: Stretching Current
features.description: At the start of its turn, the magnétanque can extend its arms, increasing the reach of its Maglock Arm attacks to 15 feet until the end of its turn.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The magnétanque makes two Maglock Arm attacks.

features.name: Maglock Arm
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). The magnétanque has Advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing ferrous armour. The magnétanque can grapple up to two creatures in this way.

features.name: Arcanomagnetic Pulse
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 15 Dexterity, each creature within 60 feet; creatures Grappled by the magnétanque have Disadvantage. Failure: 10 (3d6) Lightning damage, or 21 (6d6) Lightning damage to creatures within 20 feet. Success: Half damage.

features.name: Pulsing Hands
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 15 Strength, one creature the magnétanque can see within 90 feet. Failure: The target is moved 30 feet straight towards or away from the magnétanque (magnétanque's choice).
